data.one_liner: Flutter library for Stripe supporting PaymentSheets, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to build payment experiences in native Android and iOS apps using Flutter. Provides customizable UI screens and elements to securely collect payment details and handle payment flows.
use_when: You need to accept credit card payments, Apple Pay, or Google Pay via Stripe in your Flutter app.
You want to use pre-built payment sheets or native payment elements for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are selling digital products or services within your app that require using the app store's in-app purchase APIs (unless you are excluded by exceptions like the US court ruling).
You are looking for a non-Stripe payment gateway alternative.
strengths: Supports Payment Sheets, Apple Pay, and Google Pay out of the box.
Handles SCA and 3D Secure authentication automatically.
Provides both pre-built UI screens and modular card fields.
weaknesses: Requires specific and sometimes strict native configuration on Android (e.g., AppCompat theme, FlutterFragmentActivity) and iOS (deployment target 13.0).
Web support is experimental and only implements a subset of features.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 21+, Kotlin 1.8.0+, AGP 8+, AppCompat theme, FlutterFragmentActivity, and ProGuard rules. Requires iOS 13+ deployment target and camera usage descriptions in Info.plist if using card scanning.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use this instead if you are selling digital goods, subscriptions, or in-game items through official App Store and Google Play billing systems.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use this if you want to integrate Google Pay and Apple Pay without tying your implementation exclusively to Stripe as the processor.
